items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Golf Korea
items.text: Joaquin Niemann birdied the first playoff hole to beat Talor Gooch after both finished 12-under 268 at LIV Golf Korea, securing his first 2026 win and eighth LIV title overall.

items.headline: Preston Stout Leads NCAA Final
items.text: Oklahoma State’s Preston Stout carded a third-round 65 to lead the NCAA Championship at 11-under, one shot ahead entering Monday’s final, poised for a potential Masters invitation.
